definition: A fresh pest finding is a restaurant inspection (facility type Restaurant, result Pass, Pass w/ Conditions or Fail) whose violation text cites rodents, mice, rats, droppings, roaches, flies, insects or pests, at a license with no pest finding in the previous 180 days (the same episode definition as signal-lab H23). The weekly list is the last 7 days of inspections through the as-of date; the backfill list is the last 28 days. Pilot targeting list only: no probability of winning work is modelled.
